zh_cn.tile.openblocks.elevator.description: 将一个电梯方块在另一个电梯方块正上方三格或以上的位置,中间不能有障碍物.玩家在电梯上跳跃时就会向上传送,蹲下时就向下传送.电梯可以用染料右键染色,相同颜色的电梯才能互相传送玩家.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.heal.description: 只有在创造模式下才能得到治愈方块,它会为站在上方的玩家提供轻微的治疗效果.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.guide.description:
提供红石信号,建筑指导仪便会投影出方块轮廓.你可以通过Shift+右键它来改变形状,或者右键它的不同面来增大或减小轮廓.
创造模式下将黑曜石放在建筑指导仪上,再拿着任何方块右键它,则会自动完成搭建.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.builder_guide.descriptio:
这个强化建筑指导仪不单单能够投影出方块轮廓，还能够允许你直接放置方块。用任意方块右击中间的建筑指导仪即可！
在创造模式情况下，指导仪顶部放黑曜石，用任意方块右击能够瞬间搭建出对应的结构。
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.ladder.description: 爬梯子遇上活板门时必须跳出去是件麻烦事,但梯子活板门解决了这个问题.梯子活板门可以在打开时起到梯子的作用,让玩家顺着活板门爬上去.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.tank.description:
蓄水槽可以存储液体.它能将存储的液体自动输出或导入到相邻的其它水槽中.
你可以用桶灌入或取出液体,液态经验则可以直接被右键取出.蓄水槽在拆下后,仍然会保留其中存储的液体
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.flag.description: 旗子可以用作装饰品,或是在复杂的洞穴中竖立一个归途的标记.旗子在被放置后会朝向你放置时面对的方向,你还可以把它挂到墙上.当你Shift右键旗子时它会改变颜色.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.beartrap.description: 将捕兽夹放置在地上,再右键打开它,这样一来当有生物路过上方时就会被夹住动弹不得.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.sponge.description: 这种海绵是原版海绵的重置版.它十分利于清理一片范围内的水或岩浆.但在清理一大片液体的时候要注意了,因为它会让液体的流动变的相当混乱.
zh_cn.item.openblocks.sponge_on_a_stick.descri: 类似海绵,海绵棒可用于清理一片范围内的液体.但它比海绵更方便,也很容易坏掉.
zh_cn.item.openblocks.epic_eraser.description:
每个物品都有它的历史记录……

你讨厌这个么？
有了这东西，你能够把你那些收集的史诗级战利品的痕迹清除的干干净净，这样在黑市上售卖不会留下一点证据。
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.cannon.description: 当投掷加农炮接收到红石信号时,投掷加农炮会向指定目标投掷出相邻容器内的物品.你可以使用'指针'工具来给加农炮定位投掷的目标.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.rope_ladder.description: 当你放置绳梯后,它会垂直落到地面.创建一处绳梯只从堆叠中消耗一个物品.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.sprinkler.description:
洒水器可以催生4x4格范围内的作物.只需要将它放置在装有水的容器上方即可开始洒水.你可以放入骨粉来加快它对作物的催生速度.
洒水器也可以作为水源供给方块使用.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.paint_mixer.description:
调色器可以调出任何你想要的颜色.
在调色器最上方的格子中放入牛奶桶或任意颜料桶,在下方的四格中分别放入青色,品红色,黄色和黑色染料,然后点击按钮调色吧!
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.canvas.description: 画布是一种纯白色的方块,适合用作绘画.翻阅调色器的相关介绍来了解如何制作绘画所需的颜料桶.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.fan.description: 风扇会把正对方向的玩家,生物以及实体全都吹走.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.target.description: 靶子会根据玩家命中的环数多寡来发出强度不同的红石信号.为靶子通入红石信号可以使它竖立起来.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.path.description: 铺路石没什么额外效果.不过看起来蛮漂亮的.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.item_dropper.description: 物品投掷器类似于原版的投掷器,但它会把物品铅直地向下投掷.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.big_button.description: 大型按钮可以放置在墙上.如果你空手Shift右键它就可以打开一个格子.你可以在格子中放入不同数量的物品来控制按钮被按下后发出的红石信号持续时间的长短-每放入一个物品能使红石信号持续时间增加1个tick.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.xp_drain.description: 将经验地漏放置在蓄水槽上方,接着站上去.你的经验就会被抽入蓄水槽中,蓄水槽中存储的液态经验可以被用于自动附魔台或自动铁砧等设备.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.vacuum_hopper.descriptio: 虚空漏斗会吸收附近的掉落物或经验球并存储.你可以通过操作界面右边的设定栏来调整虚空漏斗输出物品或经验的面.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.village_highlighter.desc: 将村庄高亮仪放置在村庄内,接着给予它一个红石信号.它就能显示出村庄边界的轮廓以及铁傀儡的刷新区域.它可以用于确认临近村庄的边界或帮助你建造铁傀儡农场.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.donation_station.descrip:
你是否很喜欢某个物品或是方块,并且想对它的作者表达感谢呢?
你可以将那些物品放进捐助站,如果检测到了作者的捐助网页,我们会为你提供它的链接.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.block_placer.description: 为方块放置器通入红石信号,它就会在所朝的一格内放置它存储的方块.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.block_breaker.descriptio: 为方块采掘器通入红石信号,它就会挖掉面向的方块.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.projector.description: 用于显示由制图机器人制作的高度图.将高度图放入投影仪内,将在其上方显示3D的全息地图.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.auto_enchantment_table.d:
自动附魔台的使用方法类似于普通附魔台,但它可以通过消耗经验来自动工作.
在操作界面右边的设定栏可以调整输入经验或工具的面.自动附魔台也需要书架来提升自己的附魔等级上限.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.xp_bottler.description: 向经验装瓶器中输入液态经验,接着放入空瓶就能让它制作经验瓶.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.auto_anvil.description:
自动铁砧的使用方法类似于普通铁砧,但它可以通过消耗经验来自动工作.
在操作界面右边的设定栏可以调整输入经验或工具的面.在设定栏上可以右键拖拽铁砧或左键设定输入/输出面.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.drawing_table.descriptio: 绘图桌可以制作绘图时需要用到的模板.将空白模板放入绘图桌后通过箭头来选择你想要的模板.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.sky.normal.description: 只需要给它一个红石信号,天空方块可以让你在室内看到户外的天空.此外,我们还拥有反相天空方块.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.radio.description: 收音机可以让你连接网络收音机.首先,你需要把调台水晶(搜索地牢箱子或与村民交易)放在收音机里,并用红石信号启动.红石强度可以控制收音机的音量.在服务端的配置文件中可以设置可接收的电台.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.xp_shower.description: 将经验莲蓬头放置在存储液态经验的水槽上,它就能从中抽出经验并喷出经验球.这些喷出的经验球可以被经验地漏或MFR的排污机吸取.
zh_cn.tile.openblocks.scaffolding.description: 你是否想过通过向脚下垫方块到达高处,但是不想遗留下难看的竹子?现在你可以做到了!用这些脚手架来搭柱子,它们会在一定时间后自动散架.
zh_cn.item.openblocks.cursor.description:
游标可以让你远程控制方块.手持游标Shift右键一个方块就可以建立连接,之后用游标右键空气就控制连接的方块.
默认设置下,使用游标与方块远程互动会消耗你的经验,距离越远,消耗越多.
zh_cn.item.openblocks.dev_null.description: 手持/dev/null可以打开它的操作界面.你可以向里面放入一种物品,比如泥土.这样一来,当你从地面上捡到到泥土后就会被传送到这个格子,溢出的泥土则会自动销毁.你可以直接手持/dev/null来放置其存储的方块.
zh_cn.item.openblocks.slimalyzer.description: 带着史莱姆区块探测器到处跑,当你走进史莱姆区块时探测器上的灯会变为绿色.
zh_cn.item.openblocks.hang_glider.description:
滑翔翼的用途不言而喻.手持滑翔翼右键就可以穿上.现在,大胆跳吧!
你可以在滑翔时通过按Shift来提升速度,但是小心点,因为这会加快你下坠速度!
你的滑翔翼现在还带一个能够显示垂直空气运动情况的声控可变仪表。按下V键就可以激活。
zh_cn.item.openblocks.sleeping_bag.description: 在户外使用睡袋可以快速的度过夜晚并且不会重置出生点.只需要手持睡袋右键即可使用它.
zh_cn.item.openblocks.luggage.description:
行李箱是你的新伙伴.无论你去哪它都会跟着你,并收集地面上的掉落物.嗷!嗷!嗷!
只需要Shift右键它就可以让它变为物品形式,这样你就可以更方便的携带它.如果行李箱被闪电劈中,那么它将可以存储更多物品!
zh_cn.item.openblocks.sonic_glasses.descriptio:
请允许我向你们介绍炫酷的音波眼镜!
由开放式方块公司研发出的高科技产品,戴上它后你能看见你所听到的一切东西!
zh_cn.item.openblocks.squeegee.description: 刮刀可以从画布上刮除颜料.用它右键画布的任何一面即可刮除该面上的颜料颜料,或用它Shift右键画布来刮除所有面上的颜料颜料!
zh_cn.item.openblocks.paintbrush.description:
颜料刷可以让你在方块上涂刷任何你想要的颜色.将颜料刷在颜料桶内沾上一些颜料,就可以对方块右键来刷上颜料.
画布是最理想的涂刷方块,你也可以向原版,甚至是其它模组中的一些方块涂刷颜料.
zh_cn.item.openblocks.unprepared_stencil.descr:
"我在地牢箱子中找到了这些无聊的模板,它们能干什么?"这些模板能放上方块,配合颜料刷来对其进行涂色,空手右键模板可以旋转.
通过将一块空白模板放入绘图桌内,能制作出不同图案的模板.
zh_cn.item.openblocks.crane_backpack.descripti:
在Minecraft的世界里,磁铁是一个只在远古时代才存在的词汇.
这件十分有用的装备能让你拾取并搬运生物,玩家,物品或是方块.
背包由起重机控制器的控制.
zh_cn.item.openblocks.crane_control.descriptio:
这个高科技的无线遥控工具,能用来控制起重机背包.
右键升起,Shift+右键降低,左键拾取/释放.
当有光在闪烁时,表示物体正受到磁力影响.
zh_cn.item.openblocks.wrench.description:
这是用于对具有八面体对称性对象进行转换的，非常复杂的工具。


或者只是个粗大且笨重的金属棒，能够用来旋转一些方块。

好吧，这就是个扳手。我只是想搞些原创的东西，OK？

en_us.tile.openblocks.elevator.description: Place one elevator directly three or more blocks above another with no blocks inbetween and you'll be able to either 'jump' to move up, or 'crouch' to move down. Elevators can be dyed by clicking on them with dye, however, you can only teleport between elevators of the same color.
en_us.tile.openblocks.heal.description: The healing block is a creative-mode only block that gives off a slight healing effect over time.
en_us.tile.openblocks.guide.description:
The building guide, once powered with redstone, will give you an outline of ghost blocks in different shapes and sizes that'll help you plan out rooms.
Use touch-buttons on block to change outline dimensions and shapes.
Color of markers can be changed by using dye on central block.
en_us.tile.openblocks.builder_guide.descriptio:
This enhanced version of building guide not only displays ghost blocks to make building easier, but also allows you to place actual blocks. Just click central block with any block stack!
When in creative mode you can place an obsidian block above, then hit the building guide with any block you like to automatically create the shape.
en_us.tile.openblocks.ladder.description: The jaded ladder solves that annoying problem of jumping out of a trapdoor at the top of a ladder. The jaded ladder acts as both a trap door and a ladder at the same time.
en_us.tile.openblocks.tank.description: Tanks can hold liquids. If you place tanks next to each other and they'll distribute their liquid between the tanks. You can place liquid into the tanks using buckets. If the tank contains XP Juice you can click on them with an empty hand to give yourself some of the XP. When broken tanks will retain their liquid.
en_us.tile.openblocks.flag.description: Flags can be used for decoration or for marking the way back out of a cave you've ventured in to. The flag will point in the direction that you placed it, or you can put it on walls. If you shift-click with a flag in your hand it will change color.
en_us.tile.openblocks.beartrap.description: Place a bear trap and click on it to open it up. When a mob walks over the trap they'll be unable to move!
en_us.tile.openblocks.sponge.description: The sponge is a replacement for the vanilla sponge. Perfect for removing small pockets of lava or water. Be careful when using it on large areas of liquid though as it'll start to get quite messy.
en_us.item.openblocks.sponge_on_a_stick.descri: The sponge on a stick is a tool for cleaning up liquids. Works just like the sponge, but is more mobile at the expense of wearing out.
en_us.item.openblocks.epic_eraser.description:
Every item has its own history...

Don't you hate it?
With this item you can scrub all traces of epic lore your loot has collected over the years and then sell it on black market without worrying about evidence.
en_us.tile.openblocks.cannon.description: When given a redstone signal, the item cannon will shoot items that it finds in an adjacent inventory. Use the 'pointer' item to aim the cannon.
en_us.tile.openblocks.rope_ladder.description: When you place a rope ladder it'll roll out all the way to the ground. For every created ladder block it will use one item from stack.
en_us.tile.openblocks.sprinkler.description:
The sprinkler will help fertilize crops up to 4 blocks away. Simply place it above an OpenBlocks tank filled with water! You can also add bonemeal for an even faster rate of growth.
It also acts as a water source block!
en_us.tile.openblocks.paint_mixer.description: The paint mixer can mix any colour of paint you want! Drop either an existing paint bucket or a bucket of milk into the top slot, then cyan, magenta, yellow and black dyes into the other four slots and click mix!
en_us.tile.openblocks.canvas.description: The canvas is a perfectly white block that's perfect for painting. See the Paint Mixer for information about making paints.
en_us.tile.openblocks.fan.description: The fan will blow players, mobs or entities in the direction it's facing.
en_us.tile.openblocks.target.description: The target will give out a redstone signal of a strength relative to the accuracy of the player's aim. Give the target a redstone signal to make it pop up!
en_us.tile.openblocks.path.description: The path doesn't do anything. It just looks nice!
en_us.tile.openblocks.item_dropper.description: The item dropper is similar to the vanilla dropper, except it drops items without any random bias. User can also control speed of dropped item from GUI and with redstone power.
en_us.tile.openblocks.big_button.description: The big button is a large button that can be placed on walls. If you shift-click on the button with an empty hand it will bring up an inventory. You can put items in there to increase the length of time the button is pressed - one item increases the button press by one tick.
en_us.tile.openblocks.xp_drain.description: Place the XP drain above an OpenBlocks tank and stand on it. Your XP will drain into the tank, which can then be used for blocks such as the auto enchantment table or the auto anvil.
en_us.tile.openblocks.vacuum_hopper.descriptio: The vacuum hopper will suck up items and XP orbs around it. You can use the tabs on the right of the interface to select which sides to output to.
en_us.tile.openblocks.village_highlighter.desc: Drop the village highlighter down in a village and give it a redstone signal. It will outline the perimeter of the village and draw a box in the iron golem spawning area. Useful if you want to make sure villages don't merge into each other or you're making an iron farm!
en_us.tile.openblocks.donation_station.descrip: Love a block or item and want to show the mod developer some appreciation? Drop it into the donation station and if we know the authors donation page we'll give you a link.
en_us.tile.openblocks.block_placer.description: When given a redstone pulse the block placer will place an item in the direction it's facing.
en_us.tile.openblocks.block_breaker.descriptio: When given a redstone pulse the block breaker will break the block it's facing.
en_us.tile.openblocks.projector.description: I'll let you write this one boq!
en_us.tile.openblocks.auto_enchantment_table.d: The auto enchantment table works in a similar way to the vanilla enchantment table except it runs off XP juice. Use the tabs on the right side of the interface to select where items or xp can be pulled from. Just like with the vanilla table bookshelves are required for higher levels.
en_us.tile.openblocks.xp_bottler.description: The XP bottler will take XP juice and bottle it up into glass bottles to create bottles o' enchanting.
en_us.tile.openblocks.auto_anvil.description:
The auto anvil works just like the vanilla anvil, except it runs from XP juice and can be fully automated.

Use the tabs on the right of the GUI to select which sides of the anvil items or liquid can be inserted or extracted. Right click and drag the anvil in the tab to spin it around and select other sides!
en_us.tile.openblocks.drawing_table.descriptio: The drawing table is for creating stencils which can be used while painting. Insert an Unprepared Stencil into the drawing table then use the arrows to select which stencil you want!
en_us.tile.openblocks.sky.normal.description: Bring the outside inside with the new Sky block! Just apply a redstone signal. We also offer an inverted version.
en_us.tile.openblocks.radio.description:
The radio allows you to stream internet radio! First, you need some tuned crystals which you can find in dungeon chests or from a special villager. Place the crystal in the radio and supply it with a redstone signal to turn it on.  The redstone strength controls the volume.

You can configure which radio stations are available in the servers config file.
en_us.tile.openblocks.xp_shower.description: Attach an XP shower to a tank of XP juice and it'll pour out XP orbs. These orbs can be collected by an XP Drain or an MFR Sewer.
en_us.tile.openblocks.scaffolding.description: Have you ever wanted to pillar up somewhere without leaving an ugly tower behind? Well, now you can! Simply build with scaffolding blocks and they will automatically despawn when you are done.
en_us.item.openblocks.cursor.description:
The cursor will let you click on blocks remotely.
Simply shift-click onto a block to link the cursor, then use the cursor wherever you like to click on the target block. Be warned, by default the cursor uses up your XP relative to how far you are from the block you're clicking.
en_us.item.openblocks.dev_null.description: Click using /dev/null to open the inventory. There's a single inventory slot - put an item in there - dirt, for example. As you gather dirt from the ground this slot will fill up. Once it's full, any more dirt you pick up will be automatically discarded. You can shift-click with the item in your hand as though you were placing the block!
en_us.item.openblocks.slimalyzer.description: Walk around with the slimalyzer in your hand and it'll light up whenever you're in a slime spawning chunk.
en_us.item.openblocks.hang_glider.description:
The hang glider is self explanatory. Hold it in your hand and click to place it on your back. Now jump!
To increase your speed you can press shift while gliding, but watch out, you'll lose altitude faster!

Your hang glider now also includes an acoustic variometer indicating vertical air movement. Press V to activate it and stay up forever (or until the sun goes down)!
en_us.item.openblocks.sleeping_bag.description: The sleeping bag lets you sleep out in the wilderness without having to reset your spawn location. To sleep, simply wear it on your back.
en_us.item.openblocks.luggage.description:
Luggage is your new friend. He'll follow you around anywhere you go collecting any items he finds on the floor. Nom nom nom!
To dismantle him just shift-click on him and he'll turn into an item that you can carry around.
If he ever gets struck by lightning he'll be able to carry even more items!
en_us.item.openblocks.sonic_glasses.descriptio:
Introducing the fantabulous new Sonic Glasses!
This new and exciting technology from OpenMods Inc allow you see what you hear!
en_us.item.openblocks.squeegee.description: The squeegee removes paint from any painted blocks. Just click on the side of the block you want to remove the paint from, or alternative shift-click the block to remove paint from all sides!
en_us.item.openblocks.paintbrush.description:
Paint brushes let you paint blocks in whatever color you like!

Dab your paint brush in a Paint Can made in the Paint Mixer then click on a block to paint it.

Canvas blocks are perfect for painting, but you can also paint quite a few vanilla blocks and even some blocks from other mods. You can also place stencils on blocks and then paint over the stencil!
en_us.item.openblocks.unprepared_stencil.descr:
Stencils can be placed onto blocks and then painted over using paint brushes!

You can paint a block using multiple stencils and you can click on them with an empty hand to rotate them.

Place an Unprepared Stencil in a Drawing table to create different patterns.
en_us.item.openblocks.crane_backpack.descripti:
In Minecraft world "magnet" is ancient word for "how do this works?".

This particular piece of very equipment allows you to pick and carry mobs, players, items and blocks. Can be controlled with magnet control.
en_us.item.openblocks.crane_control.descriptio:
This hi-tech wireless remote is used for controlling magnet backpacks.

Right click to raise, Sneak + right click to lower, left click to pick/release.
Blinking light signals something is under magnet.
en_us.item.openblocks.wrench.description:
This is extremely sophisticated tool used to perform transformations of objects with octahedral symmetry.


Or just big, dumb piece of metal you can use to rotate cubes and stuff.

So yeah, it's yet another wrench. I'm just trying to be original here, ok?
